stories.title: América busca una victoria histórica frente a Chivas en el Clásico Nacional

en.title: América seeks historic victory against Chivas in the National Classic
en.summary: América hosts Chivas on Saturday in Mexico's National Classic, with manager Guillermo Almada's team targeting a historic win in this matchup.

stories.title: Pensiones en América Latina bajo presión por menor cotización

en.title: Pensions in Latin America under pressure from lower contribution rates
en.summary: Regional aging and labor informality create a gap between years worked and retirement savings, affecting workers, pension systems, and public finances across Latin America.

stories.title: Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026: Protección Civil alista alerta en 80 millones de celulares este sábado

en.title: Second National Drill 2026: Civil Protection prepares alert for 80 million cellphones this Saturday
en.summary: Mexico's Civil Protection agency will conduct a national emergency drill on September 19 at noon, sending alerts to approximately 80 million mobile phones across all 32 states.

stories.title: Carney minimiza las amenazas de Trump y celebra "nueva alianza" de Canadá con la UE

en.title: Carney downplays Trump's threats and celebrates Canada's "new alliance" with the EU
en.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney dismissed Donald Trump's threats while presenting to the European Parliament a new alliance between Canada and the EU as a guarantee of strategic autonomy.

stories.title: No necesitamos que nos juzguen desde afuera.- CSP

en.title: We do not need to be judged from outside.- CSP
en.summary: Mexico's security coordinator responded to Trump's call to prosecute officials accused of helping criminals, stating that Mexico does not require external judgment on such matters.

stories.title: Sheinbaum reacciona a dichos de Trump sobre funcionarios corruptos en México; “no necesitamos que nos juzguen desde afuera”, dice

en.title: Sheinbaum reacts to Trump's statements about corrupt officials in Mexico; "we do not need to be judged from outside", she says
en.summary: President Sheinbaum responded to Trump's remarks regarding corruption among Mexican officials, rejecting the notion that Mexico needs external judgment on internal governance issues.

stories.title: Rey Carlos III advierte contra "riesgos existenciales" de la IA si cae en "manos equivocadas"; inaugura cumbre sobre esa tecnología

en.title: King Charles III warns against "existential risks" of AI if it falls into "wrong hands"; inaugurates summit on that technology
en.summary: King Charles III opened a technology summit while cautioning about potential existential dangers posed by artificial intelligence if it becomes controlled by inappropriate parties.

stories.title: Cae en Michoacán coordinador del CJNG ligado a extorsiones

en.title: CJNG coordinator linked to extortion arrested in Michoacán
en.summary: Authorities in Michoacán apprehended a regional CJNG coordinator allegedly involved in extortion and homicides.

stories.title: Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026, horario y todo lo que hay que saber; prevén que suene alerta en 80 millones de celulares

en.title: Second National Drill 2026, schedule and everything you need to know; alert expected to sound on 80 million cell phones
en.summary: Mexico is conducting a second national emergency drill in 2026 with alerts scheduled to be sent to approximately 80 million mobile devices.

stories.title: Rey Carlos advierte a líderes del sector de la IA sobre "peligros existenciales" en cita en Escocia

en.title: King Charles warns AI sector leaders about "existential dangers" at Scotland meeting
en.summary: King Charles cautioned artificial intelligence industry leaders in Scotland about existential risks if the technology falls into wrong hands, stating that safety measures must be established urgently.

stories.title: Detienen en Michoacán a “El Señor de la T”, coordinador regional del CJNG; extorsionaba en cinco municipios

en.title: "El Señor de la T", regional coordinator of CJNG, arrested in Michoacán; extorted in five municipalities
en.summary: Authorities in Michoacán arrested a high-ranking CJNG criminal organization member who coordinated extortion operations across five municipalities.

stories.title: Carney desoye amenazas de Trump y celebra "nueva alianza" Canadá-UE; "nadie va a decirnos con quién podemos alcanzar acuerdos"

en.title: Carney disregards Trump threats and celebrates "new alliance" Canada-EU; "no one will tell us who we can reach agreements with"
en.summary: A Canadian official dismissed Trump's warnings and announced a strengthened Canada-European Union partnership, asserting that Canada determines its own trade relationships.

stories.title: PepsiCo mueve su cuenta global de medios de Omnicom a Publicis tras 25 años de relación

en.title: PepsiCo moves its global media account from Omnicom to Publicis after 25 years of relationship
en.summary: PepsiCo is transferring its global media operations to Publicis, while Omnicom will retain creative, sports, and public relations projects after more than two decades of partnership.

stories.title: Murió Vicente López Rodea, presidente de La Costeña y referente de la industria de conservas en México

en.title: Vicente López Rodea, president of La Costeña and reference figure in Mexico's canned food industry, dies
en.summary: The business executive who led the board of the food group founded by his father in 1923 and was recognized among Mexico's 100 most important businessmen has passed away.

stories.title: La UE propone prohibir las redes sociales a menores de 13 años y multar a las plataformas

en.title: EU proposes banning social media for minors under 13 and fining platforms
en.summary: The European Union has proposed legislation to prohibit social media access for children under 13 years old, with penalties for platforms. The proposal would allow supervised accounts for ages 13-14 and extends to video platforms, AI chatbots, and online games.

stories.title: Empresas de EU pactan proyectos de petróleo y oro en Venezuela con apoyo de Donald Trump

en.title: US companies reach oil and gold projects in Venezuela with Donald Trump's support
en.summary: American energy and mining companies have secured business ventures in Venezuela with backing from Donald Trump. Continental Resources is negotiating to operate an oil block containing 30 billion barrels, while Heeney Capital has obtained rights to a gold mine.

stories.title: La Fed sube la tasa de interés hasta el 4% ante presiones inflacionarias y anticipa más aumentos

en.title: The Fed raises interest rate to 4% amid inflationary pressures and anticipates further increases
en.summary: The Federal Reserve unanimously raised its benchmark interest rate to a range of 3.75% to 4% for the first time in over three years to combat inflation. The central bank signaled expectations for additional rate increases ahead.
